generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: Minimum financial turnover (civil engineering construction works) not less than two times the annual payments from this contract (Rs. xxxxx Lakhs)
Satisfactoriy completed (atleast 90%) as prime contractor at-least one such similar work of value not less than Rs. xxxxxxx (80% of estimated cost of tender)
Executed in any one year the following minimum quantities of work (Cement Concrete - xxxx cum, Earthwork - xxxx cum, etc) (80% of peak rate of construction)

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid Electrical License for executing building electrificatio works and should have executed similar electrical works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid license for executing water supply / sanitary engineering works  and should have executed similar works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year
Owning the following key and critical equipment for this work (xxxx, xxxx, xxxx)
Liquid assets and /or availability of credit facilities of no less than Rs. xxxxxx Lakhs (estimated cash flow for 3 months of peak construction period)
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
List of Financial Resources with Certificates

Technical Capability: Intending Bidder should be a regular manufacturer or supplier of Metallic Expansion Joints of Boiler Air/Flue Gas Ducts or Similar Boiler Equipment Spares. As a proof of this, bidder shall upload the relevant Valid document. OR The bidder should have experience in Overhauling works of ESP/Ducts/Dampers/Expansion Joints or similar Boiler equipment of 210 MW or above capacity Thermal Power Plants. As a proof of this, bidder shall upload the relevant Valid document

Experience: The intending bidder should have carried out the work of Supply or Erection of Metallic Expansion Joints around Primary/Secondary Air/Flue Gas Ducts of Thermal Power Plant Boilers /Similar Boiler Equipment spares of value not less than Rs. 157 Lakhs for process industries in the last five years (i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). As a proof of this, the bidder shall upload single / multiple Purchase Orders/Work Orders (Limited to maximum 3 purchase/Work orders for an amount not less than Rs. 157 Lakhs) and relevant Invoice / delivery challan for having supplied the PO materials. OR The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed, as a prime contractor, at least one similar work such as Overhauling works of ESP/Ducts/Dampers/Gates/Expansion Joints or similar boiler equipment of 210 MW of value not less than Rs. 157 Lakhs in any Thermal Power Stations of 210 MW or above capacity Units in the last five years (i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). As a proof of this, the bidder shall upload single / multiple Work Done Certificates (Limited to maximum 3 contracts for an amount not less than Rs.157 Lakhs) issued by competent authority not less than the rank of Chief engineer or equivalent. (Purchase Order / Work Order / Work done of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year 2026-27 as detailed below)

technicalCriterionList.description: Financial Turnover: The intending bidder, should have achieved minimum financial turnover of Rs. 626 Lakhs in at least two financial years during the last five years. (i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). As a proof of this, the bidder shall upload the certified copy of Profit & Loss Account or Turn over Certificate duly certified by the Chartered Accountant. (Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year 2026-27).
